given: a migrated stock table with batch_number and serial_number populated
then: the combined inventory_code column no longer exists on the stock record

independence.rationale: Earlier ACs concern adding and populating the new columns and reporting integrity; this asserts the distinct retirement of the old combined column. The new columns could be populated correctly while inventory_code is left in place, and vice versa, so it is independently breakable.

architectural_notes: Infra: the final schema-shape contract of the up migration — after backfill and integrity verification, the combined inventory_code column is dropped from the stock table so batch_number/serial_number become the canonical representation. This is a destructive DDL step ordered strictly after AC1-AC4 succeed, owned by the Alembic migration. Verified against the paired branch (R4) by inspecting the post-migration table and asserting inventory_code no longer exists.
